models.author: Daniel Elliott
models.description:
# gemma4-turbo E4B

IQ4_XS quantization of Gemma 4 E4B built from BF16 source weights using llama.cpp.
Vision projector merged directly into the model file for single-file multimodal inference.

## Files
- `gemma4-e4b-iq4xs-turbo.gguf` - Main language model (IQ4_XS quantized)
- `gemma4-e4b-iq4xs-mmproj.gguf` - Merged multimodal projector

## Stats
- 36% smaller than official Gemma 4 E4B
- 8% faster inference on CPU
- Available on Ollama: `ollama pull ssfdre38/gemma4-turbo:e4b`

instances.overview: Gemma 4 E4B quantized to IQ4_XS with merged vision projector. 36% smaller, 8% faster than official weights.
instances.usage:
## Quick Start

```bash
ollama pull ssfdre38/gemma4-turbo:e4b
ollama run ssfdre38/gemma4-turbo:e4b
```

## Files
- `gemma4-e4b-iq4xs-turbo.gguf` - Main model (IQ4_XS)
- `gemma4-e4b-iq4xs-mmproj.gguf` - Multimodal projector
